protocol.stage: confirmatory; old-study outcomes used only for method development
protocol.primary_success: For each of six claims, paired error ratio upper bootstrap bound <0.90 at one-sided 1-0.05/6 coverage, improvement in all five seeds, and category-contrast signal RMS >10*max(measured zero-update noise RMS,1e-6). Cross-model claim requires passing in both models. Incomplete jobs cannot pass.
protocol.bootstrap: 10000 paired replicates: resample model seeds, batches within kind/size strata, and probe documents independently within each category in each probe split. Reuse draws across methods and seeds; category labels fixed.
protocol.secondary: Uncentered and individual-probe errors; per-batch p50/p90; sign versus constant sign; SVD/OMP sparsity curves; rate 0.001; removal selectivity; generations. Descriptive, not additional confirmatory positive claims.
protocol.common_mode_control: Subtract each batch's mean across category means from prediction and outcome. Also score the full-gradient forecast broadcast across categories.
protocol.no_adaptation: No method, seed, step, endpoint or data changes after test evaluation starts. No stopping for a favorable result. Fixed 24-hour deadline, all failures retained.
protocol.scope: One stateless SGD update of q/v LoRA parameters after 64 fitting-data AdamW steps; category mean completion log probability, not semantic task success. Fixed-probe methods use those probes' pre-update derivatives; transfer uses independent calibration probes. SVD projection differs from Gradient Atoms EKFAC.
protocol.storage: Float32 SVD coefficients: 4*r bytes; sparse float32+uint16: 6*k bytes; OMP8 and SVD12 both 48 bytes per update. Shared basis, atoms, probe derivatives and encoding costs excluded; no runtime-speedup claim.
protocol.removal: 24 pure batches (first repeat for each category/size), rate 1e-4 only. OMP8 atom chosen by absolute calibration target-category contrast. Compare atom removal to equal-norm random removal and norm-matched rescaling.
protocol.generations: First two preset size-16 pure batches, rate 0.001; qualitative only

limitations: Five seeds; bootstrap bounds are approximate, without finite-sample guarantees.
Eight fixed categories; document resampling cannot establish new-task transfer.
Log-probability change is not task correctness or a human-validated atom explanation.
Fresh Dolly evaluation; dictionary fitting data reused from the exploratory study.
Same base model family and small LoRA updates; no full-weight or long-training claim.
